title: Brand Strategy
intro: Build a clearer position, a more recognisable identity and a story your audience can understand.
audience: For founders and marketing teams who need a stronger point of view, are entering a new market or are ready to bring an established brand up to date.
audiencePoints: New ventures shaping a first identity
Growing teams aligning products and communications
Established brands preparing a considered refresh
deliverables: A focused review of the business, audience, category and current brand materials.
A practical foundation for what the brand stands for and how it speaks.
A flexible visual direction, logo system and usage guidance shaped around the agreed strategy.
A shared reference for applying the identity across digital, campaigns and content.
process: Understand the business, people and challenge before choosing a direction.
Align on positioning, audience and the messages the brand needs to carry.
Explore and refine a distinct identity with clear feedback points.
Prepare usable assets and direction for launch and future brand work.
faqs: When should a business revisit its brand strategy?
A review can help when the business, audience or offer has changed, or when teams are finding it difficult to explain what makes the brand distinct.
Does brand strategy include a new logo?
Visual identity can be part of the scope. The work starts by agreeing on the problem and strategy, then deciding which design deliverables are useful.
Can you work with an existing brand identity?
Yes. A project can focus on positioning and messaging, or on a specific part of the identity system, depending on the brief.
